posts.description: What would be insane and hilarious for OPLA s3 to do is take advantage of Ace’s introduction to do some flashbacks of all 3 ASL brothers, but studiously avoid explaining Sabo’s backstory or how he came to join up with Ace & Luffy, leaving Netflix-only fans (who as a reminder still don’t actually know the ages of any of the characters) to speculate wildly as to which of these three boys is actually
